description: The Edit Grid consists of two components: Front-end: A Power BI custom visual that displays data in an Excel-like format. The administrator can define a valid list of values to be displayed in the grid. Back-end: The Power BI custom visual sends modified data to a backend application, which then saves the data to a SQL Server database. Edit Grid requires a license for full implementation. Please contact sales@softclouds.com for pricing. A quote will be provided which covers the license for the Edit Grid visual, Edit Grid API Server, training, and support. Training will be provided by SoftCloud's Professional Services team. Professional Services will assist with the installation and configuration of the API Server as well as best practices for both the visual and API server. The editgrid.pbix file contains Edit Grid 1.0.1.12 and the out of the box Power BI Table visual. Double clicking on any row in Edit Grid will filter the other table. Double clicking on the same row in Edit Grid again will remove the filter.
